meta.purpose: Fills the slots the templates referenced but no source file provided: gate_condition, watched_stat, activation_turn, prerequisite. Also declares alt_shape for leaders that legitimately span two guide shapes, and a name_key normalization table so the join is exact-match safe.
meta.join_key: name_key (lowercase, parenthetical suffixes stripped, ASCII only). Every one of the four files must resolve to the same name_key for a given leader.

name_key_normalization.rule: lowercase; strip anything in parentheses; trim whitespace; collapse internal double spaces
name_key_normalization.note: leadership-focus-tags.json uses ASCII-simplified names already (Ba Trieu, Joao III). leadership-focus-caveats.json matches this. The templates file's applies_to arrays used the diacritic form for Ba Trieu in one place and ASCII in others — normalize on load, do not trust either file's spelling as canonical.

alt_shapes_note: primary_shape here MUST match the leader's guide_shape field in leadership-focus-caveats.json exactly — the join script treats caveats.guide_shape as the sole source of truth for the primary shape and will use it regardless of what this file says. These fields are kept in sync manually; a mismatch here is a data bug, not a script decision. The build script also asserts primary_shape === secondary_shape never happens and logs a warning if it does.

alt_shapes.reason: Pyramid siting (turn 0-10, irreversible) is Front-Load in character and IS her caveats.json primary shape. The Pitati Archer window (turn ~20-60, expiring) is Countdown-shaped and layers on top of it.
alt_shapes.render_rule: Render the Front-Load template as the spine (already primary). After 'Turns 1-20 — Commit', insert template.Countdown.structure[1] (Phase 2 — Window) as an embedded sub-phase covering the archer window, before proceeding to Front-Load's 'Turns 20-80 — Execute'.

alt_shapes.reason: The production-burst response is a reactive stat-check and IS his caveats.json primary shape (Monitor). Baseline empire management underneath it is ordinary era-block play.
alt_shapes.render_rule: Render the Monitor template as the spine (already primary). Insert template.Linear.structure era-block phases as the 'default state' content beneath each Monitor checkpoint, so the guide reads as era blocks with a standing watch layered on top rather than a bare stat-check with no baseline plan.
